tbesh_subentries.definition_html: the two extremities, i.e. either the soles of the feet or the ankles

strongs_1890.strongs_def: cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot
strongs_1890.kjv_def: ankle, but (only), end, howbeit, less than nothing, nevertheless (where), no, none (beside), not (any, -withstanding), thing of nought, save(-ing), there, uttermost part, want, without (cause).
